subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Turbocharger
description: A fast breakdown of The Turbocharger for builders.

hook.text: A turbo uses exhaust gases spinning a tiny turbine to force extra air into the engine.

buildup.text: More air means more fuel can burn per stroke, producing far more power from the same size engine.

discovery.text: A small turbocharged four-cylinder can match the power of a naturally aspirated six-cylinder.

twist.text: The turbo is powered by energy that would otherwise be wasted out the tailpipe as heat.

climax.text: Nearly every modern brand now uses turbocharging to meet both power and emissions targets.

punchline.text: Turbocharging turns waste heat into extra horsepower.
